column1: # EXP-R2-225 Wave A, pure-text scale trajectory: stage-01 context-information
# qualification of Qwen2.5-32B on the eight frozen OpenWebText blocks.
# DISPATCH ONLY AFTER campaign_r225_qwen32b_interface.tsv RETURNS PASS for this arm.
# The draw is byte-for-byte the 7B rung's and the panel's: each expect basename carries
# the cohort digest recomputed on this workstation from the same corpus at the same
# draw, and all eight reproduce the EXP-R2-216/221 digests qwen2.5-0.5b was qualified
# on. Pool 1000, --cohort-skip 7000k for k = 0..7, n 200, character floor 800, held-out
# unigram reference 4000, --seed 20260727 -- the seed EXP-R2-225 binds the Qwen rungs
# to. Completing this rung is what lets 41_context_information_bootstrap.py form the
# wave's single shared identification report across 0.5B, 7B and 32B; until then no
# Qwen context-information quantity is identified and no rung ordering exists.
# --allow-second-stage-arms is this campaign's door and admits only
# STAGED_SECOND_STAGE_ARMS. --skip-truncation because budget.truncation_curve cannot
# compute a curve above a 1024-column live head and this arm emits 152064.
# --max-len 384 IS THE CAP. Qwen2.5-32B declares max_position_embeddings 131072.
# Stage 01 derives no length from a config, but the cap is written out because the two
# fitness stages do derive one that way and would read 131072 for this rung.
# Eight cells of one shape over three cards, so a slot barrier waits on like-shaped
# work; the last slot leaves one card idle, which is what eight cells on three cards
# costs and is cheaper than an uneven slot.
